Class CameraSpec

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.CameraSpec
public final class CameraSpec extends Object
The values entered when a camera is installed through the application.

Only the kind is checked here. The rest is checked by the camera built from it, so a specification can exist that no camera accepts; installing it fails instead.

  • Constructor Details

    • CameraSpec

      public CameraSpec(String id, String model, CameraKind kind, Resolution resolution, int bufferSeconds, int fixedAngle)
      Records what was entered for a new camera.
      Parameters:
      id - the camera's identifier
      model - the camera's model
      kind - which camera to build; only an installable kind
      resolution - the resolution it records at
      bufferSeconds - how many seconds its buffer holds
      fixedAngle - the angle of a fixed camera; ignored for any other kind
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the kind is missing or is not installable — a stream camera is connected with its stream, not installed from a form
